+# IVX Android Release APK Build + Emulator QA
+#
+# Builds a RELEASE APK (with JS bundle + assets) using the committed
+# expo/android/ directory, then installs it on an emulator and runs Maestro QA.
+#
+# Proven path mirrors ivx-ci.yml android-apk job:
+#   - bun install at root + expo
+#   - NO expo prebuild --clean (uses committed android/ directory)
+#   - assembleRelease
+#   - explicit JAVA_HOME / ANDROID_HOME
+#
+# Triggers:
+#   - Push to main (when chat files, Maestro flows, or this workflow change)
+#   - Manual dispatch via GitHub Actions UI
+
+name: Android Emulator QA
+
+on:
+  push:
+    branches: [main]
+    paths:
+      - 'expo/app/ivx/chat.tsx'
+      - 'expo/src/modules/chat/**'
+      - 'expo/.maestro/**'
+      - 'expo/eas.json'
+      - 'expo/app.config.ts'
+      - 'expo/package.json'
+      - 'expo/assets/images/**'
+      - 'expo/plugins/**'
+      - '.github/workflows/android-emulator-qa.yml'
+  workflow_dispatch:
+    inputs:
+      run_full_qa:
+        description: 'Run full chat QA (requires OWNER_PASSWORD secret)'
+        required: false
+        default: false
+        type: boolean
+
+env:
+  EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL: https://api.ivxholding.com
+  EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL }}
+  EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY: ${{ secrets.EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY }}
+  EXPO_PUBLIC_QA_BUILD: 'true'
+  OWNER_EMAIL: iperez4242@gmail.com
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+  issues: write
+
+jobs:
+  build-and-test:
+    name: Android Release APK Build + Emulator QA
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 60
+    outputs:
+      build_status: ${{ steps.build.outputs.build_status }}
+      apk_path: ${{ steps.apk.outputs.path }}
+      apk_hash: ${{ steps.apk.outputs.hash }}
+      apk_size: ${{ steps.apk.outputs.size }}
+      emulator_name: ${{ steps.emu.outputs.name }}
+      android_version: ${{ steps.emu.outputs.version }}
+      emulator_status: ${{ steps.emu.outcome }}
+
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout code
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          fetch-depth: 1
+
+      - name: Setup Bun
+        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
+
+      - name: Setup Java 17
+        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
+        with:
+          distribution: 'temurin'
+          java-version: '17'
+
+      - name: Setup Android SDK
+        uses: android-actions/setup-android@v3
+        with:
+          packages: 'platform-tools platforms;android-36 build-tools;36.0.0 ndk;27.1.12297006 cmake;3.22.1'
+          log-accepted-android-sdk-licenses: false
+
+      - name: Install root dependencies
+        run: bun install
+
+      - name: Install Expo dependencies
+        working-directory: expo
+        run: bun install
+
+      - name: Verify tooling
+        working-directory: expo
+        run: |
+          echo "=== Tool versions ==="
+          bun --version
+          node --version
+          npx expo --version
+
+      # ============================================================
+      # Build release APK using committed android/ directory.
+      # continue-on-error lets the log upload step run on failure.
+      # ============================================================
+      - name: Build Android release APK
+        id: build
+        working-directory: expo/android
+        timeout-minutes: 30
+        env:
+          JAVA_HOME: ${{ env.JAVA_HOME }}
+          ANDROID_HOME: ${{ env.ANDROID_SDK_ROOT }}
+        run: |
+          set -o pipefail
+          echo "=== Building release APK with Gradle ==="
+          echo "JAVA_HOME=$JAVA_HOME"
+          echo "ANDROID_HOME=$ANDROID_HOME"
+          chmod +x gradlew
+          ./gradlew assembleRelease --no-daemon -x lint 2>&1 | tee gradle-build.log
+          GRADLE_EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
+          echo "=== Gradle exit code: $GRADLE_EXIT ==="
+          echo "build_exit=$GRADLE_EXIT" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
+          if [ "$GRADLE_EXIT" -eq 0 ]; then
+            echo "build_status=success" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
+          else
+            echo "build_status=failed" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

+            tail -400 gradle-build.log
+            echo "### Build Failure — Last 400 Lines" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
+            echo '```' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
+            tail -400 gradle-build.log >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
+            echo '```' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
+            exit 1
+          fi
+
+      # ALWAYS run — uploads the full Gradle log even when the build fails.
+      - name: Upload Gradle build log
+        if: always()
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: ivx-android-release-gradle-log-${{ github.sha }}
+          path: expo/android/gradle-build.log
+          retention-days: 30
+
+      # Create a diagnostic GitHub issue if the build failed.
+      - name: Create diagnostic issue on build failure
+        if: always() && steps.build.outcome != 'success'
+        continue-on-error: true
+        working-directory: expo/android
+        env:
+          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
+        run: |
+          echo "::error::Gradle release build failed. Creating diagnostic issue with error logs."
+          {
+            echo "## Android Release APK Build Diagnostics"
+            echo ""
+            echo "**Commit:** ${GITHUB_SHA}"
+            echo "**Run:** ${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"
+            echo "**Build step outcome:** ${{ steps.build.outcome }}"
+            echo ""
+            echo "### Gradle build output (last 800 lines)"
+            echo '```'
+            tail -800 gradle-build.log 2>/dev/null || echo "gradle-build.log not found"
+            echo '```'
+          } > diagnostic-body.md
+          # Create issue via GitHub API (gh CLI sometimes fails silently in this runner)
+          RESPONSE=$(curl -s -X POST \
+            -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ github.token }}" \
+            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
+            -d "$(python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.dumps({'title':'Android Release APK Build Diagnostics — ${GITHUB_SHA:0:12}','body':open('diagnostic-body.md').read(),'labels':['android-qa-diagnostic']}))")" \
+            "https://api.github.com/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/issues")
+          echo "Issue create response: $RESPONSE"
+          echo "$RESPONSE" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('Created issue:', d.get('html_url', d.get('message','unknown')))"
+
+      - name: Find built APK
+        id: apk
+        working-directory: expo/android
+        if: steps.build.outcome == 'success'
+        run: |
+          echo "=== Searching for release APK ==="
+          APK_PATH=$(find app/build/outputs/apk/release -name "*.apk" -type f 2>/dev/null | head -1)
+          if [ -z "$APK_PATH" ]; then
+            echo "::error::No release APK found"
+            find . -name "*.apk" 2>/dev/null
+            exit 1
+          fi
+          APK_PATH_ABS="$(cd "$(dirname "$APK_PATH")" && pwd)/$(basename "$APK_PATH")"
+          echo "path=$APK_PATH_ABS" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
+          echo "APK found: $APK_PATH_ABS"
+          ls -lh "$APK_PATH_ABS"
+          APK_HASH=$(sha256sum "$APK_PATH_ABS" | awk '{print $1}')
+          echo "hash=$APK_HASH" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
+          echo "APK SHA256: $APK_HASH"
+          APK_SIZE=$(stat -c%s "$APK_PATH_ABS" 2>/dev/null || stat -f%z "$APK_PATH_ABS" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
+          echo "size=$APK_SIZE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
+          echo "APK size: $APK_SIZE bytes"
+
+      - name: Upload APK artifact
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        if: steps.build.outcome == 'success'
+        with:
+          name: ivx-android-apk-${{ github.sha }}
+          path: ${{ steps.apk.outputs.path }}
+          retention-days: 30
+          if-no-files-found: error
+
+      - name: Boot Emulator + Install APK + Launch + QA
+        id: emu
+        continue-on-error: true
+        if: steps.build.outcome == 'success'
+        uses: reactivecircus/android-emulator-runner@v2
+        with:
+          api-level: 34
+          arch: x86_64
+          profile: pixel_7
+          target: google_apis
+          disable-animations: true
+          emulator-options: -no-window -gpu swiftshader_indirect -no-snapshot -noaudio -no-boot-anim
+          script: |
+            echo "=== Emulator booted ==="
+            adb devices
+            EMU_NAME=$(adb shell getprop ro.product.model 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown")
+            ANDROID_VER=$(adb shell getprop ro.build.version.release 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown")
+            echo "name=$EMU_NAME" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
+            echo "version=$ANDROID_VER" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
+            echo "Emulator: $EMU_NAME (Android $ANDROID_VER)"
+
+            echo "=== Installing APK ==="
+            adb install -r "${{ steps.apk.outputs.path }}" || {
+              echo "::warning::APK install failed — capturing diagnostics"
+              adb logcat -d -t 200 > logcat.txt 2>&1 || true
+              adb exec-out screencap -p > screenshot-01-install-fail.png 2>/dev/null || true
+              exit 1
+            }
+            echo "APK installed successfully"
+
+            echo "=== Launching app ==="
+            adb shell am start -n com.ivxholdings.app/.MainActivity || {
+              echo "::warning::App launch failed — capturing diagnostics"
+              adb logcat -d -t 200 > logcat.txt 2>&1 || true
+              adb exec-out screencap -p > screenshot-02-launch-fail.png 2>/dev/null || true
+              exit 1
+            }
+            sleep 10
+            adb exec-out screencap -p > screenshot-01-launch.png 2>/dev/null || true
+            echo "Launch screenshot saved"
+
+            echo "=== Capturing logcat ==="
+            adb logcat -d -t 500 > logcat.txt 2>&1 || true
+
+            echo "=== Installing Maestro ==="
+            curl -Ls "https://get.maestro.mobile.dev" | bash || {
+              echo "::warning::Maestro install failed — skipping Maestro tests"
+              echo "maestro_result=skipped" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
+              adb exec-out screencap -p > screenshot-02-post-test.png 2>/dev/null || true
+              exit 0
+            }
+            echo "$HOME/.maestro/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
+            export PATH="$HOME/.maestro/bin:$PATH"
+            maestro --version || echo "Maestro version check failed"
+
+            echo "=== Running Maestro launch test ==="
+            cd "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/expo"
+            maestro test .maestro/ivx-app-launch.yaml --format junit --output maestro-launch-results.xml 2>&1 | tee maestro-launch.log || true
+            echo "maestro_result=completed" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
+            echo "Maestro launch test completed"
+
+            echo "=== Post-test screenshot ==="
+            adb exec-out screencap -p > screenshot-02-post-test.png 2>/dev/null || true
+
+      - name: Emulator QA diagnostics
+        if: always() && steps.emu.outcome != 'success' && steps.build.outcome == 'success'
+        env:
+          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
+        run: |
+          echo "::warning::Emulator QA failed or was skipped. Creating diagnostic issue."
+          {
+            echo "## Android Emulator QA Diagnostics"
+            echo ""
+            echo "**Commit:** ${GITHUB_SHA}"
+            echo "**Run:** ${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"
+            echo "**APK:** Built successfully, found"
+            echo "**APK Hash:** ${{ steps.apk.outputs.hash }}"

+            echo "**Emulator step outcome:** ${{ steps.emu.outcome }}"
+            echo ""

+            echo '```'
+            tail -200 logcat.txt 2>/dev/null || echo "logcat not found"
+            echo '```'

+            echo "### Maestro log"
+            echo '```'

+
+      - name: Upload all QA artifacts
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        if: always()
